title: Encoder descriptor selection resolver scaffold
summary: Add a pure descriptor-owned encoder selection resolver that returns primary and CPU fallback descriptors plus trace evidence without wiring it into Do-Encode.
reason: Encoder breadth activation needs a single resolver for literal codec selection, concrete backend selection, capability rejection, and HDR fallback blocking before active command generation can safely consume non-HEVC descriptors.
behavior_before: Descriptor helpers could resolve individual descriptors, capability probes, and CPU fallback targets, but there was no single pure resolver returning primary/fallback descriptor choices with trace evidence for future activation wiring.
behavior_after: Resolve-MediaEncoderSelection maps codec family/backend choices to primary descriptors, attaches safe CPU fallback descriptors where available, records trace entries, handles capability-probe rejection by exposing fallback, and fails closed for unsupported backends, unsupported literal CPU codecs, and HDR-unsafe descriptors. The active resolver and Do-Encode path remain unchanged.
